description: Run real Lighthouse on the current authenticated tab without opening a debugging port. Returns category scores, failing audits, flagged DOM nodes, and HTML/JSON reports. Navigation reloads the tab; snapshot audits its current state. Built-in runtime; no Node installation required.

categories.description: Default accessibility, best-practices, seo; performance is optional

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

device.description: Scoring form factor; current viewport is preserved

limit.description: Maximum failing audits inline; full report always saved

outputDirPath.description: Directory for HTML and JSON reports
